entries.notes: Standing lat pulldown with a green elastic band (high resistance, 15-35 kg depending on stretch; 25 kg nominal), 4 sets of 15 repetitions in about 5 minutes. rest_between_sets_s is a nominal placeholder, pending Aguado: the protocol only says very short recoveries. Likewise rep_duration_s, rest_between_reps_s, gap_s and rom_deg are provisional values pending Aguado (#106). EMG on each latissimus dorsi, ~10 cm between electrodes, ground on the iliac crest; IMU at T9; cord C3-C4 to L5-S1.
Passive spine_check, standing, just before (phase pre) and just after (phase post) the exercise session.
